## Problem

What interoperability problem does this solve?

## Admission checklist

A concept may enter this artifact only when all are true:

- [ ] At least three projects require it, or two plus TeamCode duplication
- [ ] Semantics are identical
- [ ] Sharing reduces adapters or ambiguity
- [ ] No FTC, Android, hardware, or remaining domain behavior
- [ ] Unlikely to change frequently
- [ ] Clear invariants and tests
- [ ] Does not force one functional project to depend on another
- [ ] Does not introduce runtime authority

## Scope

- Motivation
- In scope
- Out of scope
- Acceptance criteria
- Required tests / docs
